name: Makab Horazon: Ang Kuryer
storyline: Patricio is a newly assigned courier for one of the big bosses of the Makab Horazon underworld. To prove himself worthy of his position, he must deliver the package to the clients without fail. This sounds easy on paper until that paper only contains the names of the clients and some vague clues about their location.
summary: Makab Horazon: Ang Kuryer is a 2D point-and-click game where the player has to interact with the world to complete the protagonist's task.
